mapper.select:
WITH segment_id AS ( SELECT CAST(NULLIF(R.SEGMENT_ID, '') AS INTEGER) AS SEGMENT_ID FROM tms_books_segment_relation R WHERE R.BOOK_NO = #{bookNo} AND R.SEGMENT = #{segmentName} ) SELECT E.FLEX_VALUE || '_' || E.DESCRIPTION AS CODEORNAME, e.flex_value AS key, e.description AS value, E.SEGMENTS_IS_RELEVANCY_FLAG as attribute1, E.BUSINESS_TYPE AS attribute2 FROM tms_segment_value E WHERE E.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID = (SELECT SEGMENT_ID FROM segment_id)
AND E.FLEX_VALUE || '_' || E.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' || #{codeOrName} || '%'
ORDER BY E.FLEX_VALUE
